fact: The Implementer supports feature, refactoring, bug-fix, perf-issue, hillclimb, experiment and experiment-fix playbooks.
Implementer dispatch selects a versioned playbook from the task type or the Taskbook Playbook field and loads its prompt for each Work State.
The plugin supplies the named-team implementer with bundled adaptations of PStack methods.
The repository catalogs adopted PStack and Matt Pocock methods in reference/pstack.json and reference/matt.json respectively.
The shipped catalogs retain callable adaptations. The inventory of upstream-only or excluded workflows, playbooks and automation prompts is available in the earlier catalogs in Git.

Design and Implement can select the PStack how and why investigation states. Design drafting and revision load architect, diagnosis loads fix-root-causes, and implementation verification loads prove-it-works.
